thread:
elaine: heads up — deploybot just blocked a canary promote for service-payments. Reason: provenance_label_missing (ci.buildid). image: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/service-payments:canary-20260321

deploy-bot: Promote aborted: provenance_check failed. Missing label: `ci.buildid`. See logs: /var/log/deploybot/promote/1749501234.log

mike: ugh. did we switch builders on that repo? iirc the new kaniko job changed label keys a week ago.

samir: yep — we moved to kaniko v2 on Monday. it writes `build.id` instead of `ci.buildid`. reconciliation hook didn't map the alias.

elaine: confirmed. the image pushed fine but provenance guard compares `ci.buildid` so deploybot sees it as unproven. digest is sha256:ab12cd34ef56...

mike: options: 1) retag the old digests with the new tag and repush with legacy label 2) update deploybot's provenance mapping to accept `build.id` 3) manually pin the canary to the known-good digest and promote with an override.

release-manager: we need minimal blast radius. option 3 seems fastest for this canary window. if we change mapping it's larger QA/backwards-compat scope and may affect Dedicated customers.

samir: agree. manual pin -> promote -> run smoke tests -> update mapping later. i've got a good copy of the verified digest: `sha256:ab12cd34ef56a7890beef...` (shortened).

elaine: can someone run the promote pin command? i'm with infra on another incident.

mike: running: `deploybot promote --repo service-payments --tag canary-20260321 --pin sha256:ab12cd34ef56a7890beef --force --reason "provenance label mismatch, manual pin for canary"`

deploy-bot: Promote started (manual override). Pin applied: sha256:ab12cd34ef56a7890beef. Running canary rollout to 5% nodes in us-west-2.

samir: smoke: `curl -sS https://canary-us-west-2.service-payments.redwood.cloud/health | jq .status` -> "ok" on two canary pods.

release-manager: good. schedule a short change window and add to release notes: note that canary was manually pinned due to CI label key migration; outreach to integrators if they reference floating tags. Change window: 14:00-14:30 PT today. please add entry to changelog.

mike: adding to release notes now. also creating a follow-up ticket to update deploybot provenance mapping and run a one-off backfill to mark recent images with both keys.

elaine: thanks team. next action: samir to open mapping PR, mike to backfill tags if necessary, release-manager to publish short blurb in release notes. i'll close the canary monitor after 30m if no regressions. :thumbsup:

samir: PR filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploybot/pull/412 — adds `build.id` alias.

mike: backfill script queued: `scripts/backfill-provenance --repo service-payments --from 2026-03-20 --to 2026-03-22`

deploy-bot: Promote complete: canary at 5% healthy. override recorded in audit: user=mike, reason="provenance label mismatch".

release-manager: published release notes draft to /docs/releases/2026-03-21.md and pinged #customers-notify for integrator heads.

elaine: marking resolved for now. will reopen if any canary alerts pop. :white_check_mark:

mike: reaction :party:

samir: reaction :shipit:
